name: Emissions selection — no supplier data, Annex VI default with the 2027 mark-up
why: The default path is the one most importers land on: the EU's own figures show 89-92% of declarants used default values in the first year. This case pins the whole chain in one result — Annex VI lookup, the 20% mark-up for 2027, the rejection reasons for the methods that were passed over, and the version stamps that make the figure reproducible. It is also the case that moves if the mark-up table is ever re-versioned, which is the single sanctioned exception in the plan.

decision_trace.detail: No supplier direct emissions found in extraction output.
No supplier direct emissions at required confidence. Falling back to Annex VI default values.
Annex VI default applied: direct=46305.000 kgCO2e, indirect=7840.000 kgCO2e (SEE=2.210 tCO2e/t, source: EU 2023/1773 Art.4(3) Default Values, DG TAXUD Dec 2023)
Default-value mark-up of 20% applied to the Annex VI figures for reporting year 2027: direct=55566.000 kgCO2e, indirect=9408.000 kgCO2e (table 2026-eu-v1)
